errors.evidence: The description implies these colors are part of the text, but the atom checklist specifies they are part of the figure's legend. The machine-generated description incorrectly states the legend is 'част от текстовото описание'.
The description omits the y-axis range (0 to 1200) and interval (200), which are critical for interpreting the figure.
The description does not explicitly state that the bars are grouped for each year, which is a key structural feature of the chart.

The description omits the color mapping for Spain (blue), France (gray), China (orange), Italy (yellow), Turkey (light green), USA (green), and Argentina (dark blue), which are specified in the atom checklist.
The description does not mention the stability of values for all countries, which is a critical observation in the atom checklist.
